title: myls
summary: ls -1 with -a and directories marked with a slash, sorted by name.
hints: Read the names with `readdir` into a growing array, skipping `.` and `..` (and the names that start with `.` unless `-a`), sort with `qsort` and `strcmp`.
A name is a directory if `opendir("DIR/name")` works: build the path with `snprintf` and close it again with `closedir`.
